description.value: Hot Pan Pizza is a multi-location pizza chain with outlets in Richmond, Vancouver, and Surrey, offering hand-crafted pizzas baked in stone ovens using traditional recipes and premium ingredients. The Richmond location on Alexandra Road is one of three BC locations, each offering online ordering and a full menu of classic and specialty pizzas. The business also provides catering services for corporate events, weddings, and private parties.
